title: well made but small
text: well made but small. These are well made but they are small.  Most cream brûlée recipes expect the ramekin to hold at least 100ml.  These will hold a bit more than 75 ml.  If you try to put 100ml it will go to the very top instead of 3/4's full.  I'm keeping because well they are very pretty and very well made.  The description is very miss leading.  Even full to the top they can't hold 4 oz.  Disappointing.

product_metadata.title: Sweese 504.001 Porcelain Ramekins Oval Shape - 4 Ounce for Creme Brulee - Set of 6, 4.7 x 3.2 x 1 Inch, White
features: EXQUISITE RAMEKINS FOR CREME BRULEE - Crème brûlée is a dessert consisting of a rich custard base topped with a contrasting layer of hard caramel. In order to have the right crust-to-filling ratio, crème brulee can't be made in a dish taller than 1 inch or so. If creme brulee is in the larger and deeper dishes, that will make one feel sick after eating it. Sweese creme brulee ramekin is the right one and let everyone enjoy delicious food without worrying over-eat!

GOOD SIZE FOR VARIOUS FOOD - Sweese ramekins are perfect for creme brulee, individual side dishes, quiche, baked mac and cheese, poached or shirred eggs, and serving dipping sauces. And they are just the right size for kids little hands which make them easy to hold.

BRIGHT ASSORTED COLORING - Sweese porcelain souffle dish have industry-favorite traditional contours, and assorted color adds a stylistic touch and brightens up your mornings. Sleek ramekins are sure to create a dining experience your guests won't soon forget.

PRO-GRADE PORCELAIN & SAFE FOR DISHWASHER, MICROWAVE, OVEN AND FREEZER - These Sweese ramekins are made of durable porcelain, a type of premium LEAD-FREE ceramic, chip-resistant and more sturdy than stoneware. Creation of Sweese ensures you get what you pay for.
COOKS EVENLY & EASY-RELEASE - Sweese’s ceramic construction offers even heating and superior heat retention. Non-stick glazed surfaces make release easier.
